$comment: Contract for data/tables/grades.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Grades
description: One row per exact commercial, study or resin-reference grade. A grade belongs to exactly one material.

fields.name: GradeID
fields.description: Stable grade identifier: G + material number + sequence; -R# marks a study or resin-reference grade. The sequence is two digits to 99 and three from 100, because a generic material collects one grade per manufacturer.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: procurement: a buyable filament grade; study: a research specimen grade; reference: a moulded resin reference. Non-procurement grades carry an -R# ID suffix (checked by the build).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: active or retired. A retired grade stays as an audit record and backs nothing.

fields.name: Shared formulation key
fields.description: Grades with the same key share one formulation.

fields.name: Variant
fields.description: The product is a variant its material's Modifier / filler does not describe (schema/vocab/grade-variants.csv). Its values stay its own; the estimate model gives it a variant covariate so it does not pull its family. Say why in Composition / filler.

fields.name: Availability
fields.description: Availability as recorded. Retirement is Status, not this text.

fields.name: Selected-grade rationale
fields.description: Why this grade was selected or retired.
